fastening_system: M3x10 self-tapping screws into Ø4.5 printed bosses (Ø2.5 pilot, 0.5 mm entry chamfer) for all shell seams and module caps; M4x12 machine screws with hex-nut pockets ONLY at MG996R lug seats on the datasheet 4-hole 49.5 x 10.0 pattern (both shoulder bays and both hip bays, servo drops into pocket from the open bay face with 0.5 mm air per side, 0.15-0.20 insertion fit at lug seats); 2x brass M3 heat-set inserts at the torso main seam top-deck bosses that see repeated service opening.
seam_strategy: Torso splits into a convex chest shell and curved back shell on the lateral plane y=0: full-perimeter tongue-and-groove (tongue 1.5 wide x 1.5 deep, location fit 0.15, 0.5 mm lead-in chamfer on the tongue), fastened by 6 M3 bosses (2 at top deck z=298, 2 at pectoral line z=255, 2 at pelvis z=170); back shell is the service door for the electronics bay. Head splits helmet-front (carrying the visor recess) / helmet-rear on the vertical plane behind the visor, same tongue-and-groove + 2 M3 bosses entering from below the neck collar. Each limb segment is one lofted shell closed by its joint-module dome caps; every segment-to-module interface registers on a 1.0 mm annular lip (location fit 0.15, 0.5 mm chamfer) at the crisp panel seam line and screws with 2 M3 into internal bosses. Servo bays open outward through the shoulder/hip module faces so servos drop in before the caps close.
wiring_route: Shoulder servo leads exit each bay through a Ø8 grommet hole in the bay inner wall at (±40, -15, 278), drop down twin 8 x 6 printed spine channels moulded into the back shell either side of the spine crease, and enter the electronics bay (lower back, z=190-230) through 10 x 6 slots; hip servo leads exit through Ø8 grommet holes in the pelvis deck at (±30, -12, 192) and rise directly into the same bay; all four terminate at the bus board on the back-shell inner face, serviced by removing the back shell.
